messages.subject: Multiple conditions in UI.R
parts:
Hello experienced shiny developers,

I need to plot different graphs depending on the user input, so I have
 verticalLayout(
                   
                     tableOutput("countTable_one"),
                     tableOutput("countTable_two"),
                    
                    # first conditional panel
                     conditionalPanel("input.xx1.length ==1",
                                       showOutput("xxbar", "nvd3")
                                              
                                      
                     ),
                    # second conditional panel
                     conditionalPanel("input.xx1.length ==2",
                                       fluidRow(column(6,showOutput("xxbar", "nvd3"),plotOutput("nullplot1",width="auto")),
                                                column(6,showOutput("xxbartwo", "nvd3")))
                                      
                     ),
                      fluid = T)                              
        ),

It works with either only the first conditional panel or the second, but not if I have both. If I had both conditions in, all conditional inputs are messed up, i.e: only the common inputs will be shown.

Any idea or suggestion how to fix this?

Thank you in advance!

messages.author: 786c3f8c5caf6038
messages.subject: Re: Multiple conditions in UI.R
parts: My friend pointed out that xxbar was written twice here. So I made a copy of it and changed its name. Now it's working!
